papers.title: Caravanserai note
lines: The Büyük Han was built for merchants, with rooms around a courtyard and a mosque in the middle.
Now it holds craftsmen and cafes. The coffee is better than the camels.

papers.title: Walls guide's note
lines: The walls of Nicosia are a Venetian star with eleven points. The city is split along its middle.
The guide pointed and said: this is the north, this is the south, this is the bit where we agree.

papers.title: Postcard from northern Nicosia
lines: The coffee is thick, the baklava is thicker, and the sun has cheerfully ignored my sunscreen.
Thinking of home. Mostly the rain.

papers.title: Note on a bag
lines: Simit: sesame ring bread, still warm, from a barrow at dawn. Eat on the walk, not at the table.
The bag also contained a postcard. The postcard said: 'Glad you came.'
